question: Does a band that widens with sqrt(time), recalibrated weekly on the four prior weeks, score better than the frozen Cycle Navigator daily bands on the same issue clock and data?

model.P0: last hourly close fully closed at or before T0
model.sigma: sample std of the last 168 hourly log returns ending at P0
model.h_k: hours from T0 to the end of UTC day k
model.band: P0*exp(+-z_q*sigma*sqrt(h_k)); families: range (day low/high) and close
model.z: q-quantile of needed z over completed asset-days of the 4 prior ISO weeks (proxy issue Monday 08:00Z), >=40 rows else 8 weeks else seed

issue_clock: T0 = first introduction of the original CN weekly freeze path along verified main first-parent history, using commit committer timestamp as Git availability proxy ONLY; first actual HTTP/consumer delivery remains UNKNOWN until independently evidenced. A branch-only or shallow-history path is rejected. The Challenger issuance must additionally be on main, byte-identical to its original blob, before the first outcome observation. No reconstruction at scoring.

scoring.primary: mean CLOSE interval score at alpha=0.2 over identical paired matured asset-days A vs CN source-issued daily RANGE band evaluated against close (a proxy comparison, not proof CN issued a close forecast). Separate A-all calibration stats and paired A/CN scores; never mix denominators.
secondary: Full-day RANGE containment A q80 vs CN source-issued range, on same paired complete hourly days
Close-in-band A/CN on paired complete days
Mean width A/CN and prior-week-close-centered equal-width CN benchmark (#2118), on same clock/asset/day
A calibration: empirical coverage q50/q80/q95 for range and close, separately labelled A-only
scoring.cluster: ISO week (BTC and ETH share weeks)

decision_rule.confirmatory_look: Exactly one, after eight consecutive scheduled ISO week clusters W47 2026 to W01 2027 have complete paired evaluable outcomes. Do not test significance during intermediate weeks and do not extend the horizon to rescue a result.
decision_rule.win: A passes SHADOW-only confirmatory test iff exactly 8 of 8 scheduled non-tied weekly paired primary scores favor A; two-sided exact sign p=0.0078125. Seven of eight wins gives p=0.0703125, not a pass. CN or tied/missing weeks preclude acceptance.
decision_rule.ties_and_missing: Any missing pair or tied weekly primary winner at the fixed analysis cut results in INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass; no optional extension or replacing a missing scheduled week.
decision_rule.multiple_looks: Fixed-sample 8-week single look, no sequential alpha-spending needed because no repeat p-value testing. Weekly scores may be monitored descriptively without inferential threshold checks.
decision_rule.else: CN stays official; A remains SHADOW (revisions require independently reviewed preregistration before a NEW prospective series).
never: change an original frozen CN or Challenger issuance after the first main blob
promote on <8 prospective weeks, a partial or tied week, or a reversed significance result
post-select later weeks, data or stop time to improve p
change params, seed or formula without a separately preregistered version

design_selection_disclosure: The estimator/window were selected among 9 alternatives on W39-W46 retrospective/simulated data, N=90 asset-days; W46 itself was selection-exposed, not independent holdout. Any W46 score is descriptive, not proof of forward edge.

code.ci: .github/workflows/data-architecture-gate.yml step 'Validate Task2 Challenger A sqrt-time volatility band'

weekly_operation: Two governed phases on existing owner workflow: (1) after original CN freeze first enters main, run ISSUE once using current eligible PIT hourly data and source/clock proof, store and merge immutable frozen Challenger JSON on main BEFORE day-one outcomes; no later reissuance or backfill. (2) only after days mature, run SCORE, which reads original first-main JSON and checks source ancestry; write score alongside settlement. Both integration and public site producer are separate, reviewed, no additional schedule; absence of issuer yields ABSTAIN.

observation_integrity.range_and_close_day: All expected hourly bars from ceiling(T0) to UTC day-end must exist exactly once. Minimum six bars remains a lower bound, not permission for gaps.
observation_integrity.missing_hour: ABSTAIN day, no range or close score, not imputed.
observation_integrity.calibration: Exclude any prior-week asset-day with an incomplete expected hourly census.

source_integrity.immutable_issuance: Persist original issue JSON in 06_RESEARCH_LAB/task2_challenger_a/issued/YYYY/Www/CHALLENGER_A_FROZEN_ISSUANCE.json, merge on main before outcomes; score ONLY original first-main bytes, verifying issuer SHA, freeze SHA/commit/clock and that neither has changed.
source_integrity.authoritative_clock: First-parent refs/heads/main Git commit committer time, NOT independent external delivery confirmation.
source_integrity.data_quality: Source hourly files may be revised; the issued bands MUST NEVER be recreated from later CSV during scoring; complete daily UTC census required.
source_integrity.public_site: Site Prognose Challenger A is SHADOW/PENDING until a separately reviewed public producer proves original source first-main issuance and readback. The site never promotes this model to official.
